en.longDescription:
Formbricks is an open-source survey and experience management platform for in-product and link surveys, NPS, and feedback analytics.

Includes PostgreSQL (pgvector), Redis, Formbricks Hub, and Cube. Set WEBAPP_URL / NEXTAUTH_URL via SERVICE_URL_FORMBRICKS to your public URL. Complete the setup wizard on first launch.

de.longDescription:
Formbricks ist eine Open-Source-Plattform für Umfragen und Experience Management für In-Produkt- und Link-Umfragen, NPS und Feedback-Analytik.

Enthält PostgreSQL (pgvector), Redis, Formbricks Hub und Cube. Setze WEBAPP_URL / NEXTAUTH_URL über SERVICE_URL_FORMBRICKS auf deine öffentliche URL. Schließe den Einrichtungsassistenten beim ersten Start ab.

fr.shortDescription: Sondages open source et gestion de l'expérience
fr.longDescription:
Formbricks est une plateforme open source de gestion des sondages et de l'expérience pour les sondages intégrés et par lien, le NPS et l'analytique des retours.

Inclut PostgreSQL (pgvector), Redis, Formbricks Hub et Cube. Définissez WEBAPP_URL / NEXTAUTH_URL via SERVICE_URL_FORMBRICKS vers votre URL publique. Terminez l'assistant de configuration au premier lancement.

pt.shortDescription: Pesquisas open-source e gestão de experiência
pt.longDescription:
Formbricks é uma plataforma open-source de pesquisas e gestão de experiência para pesquisas no produto e por link, NPS e análises de feedback.

Inclui PostgreSQL (pgvector), Redis, Formbricks Hub e Cube. Defina WEBAPP_URL / NEXTAUTH_URL via SERVICE_URL_FORMBRICKS para sua URL pública. Conclua o assistente de configuração no primeiro acesso.
